# A pure js: function is run by node over the project's modules at build time,
# which is the project's code running: refused unasked, like go:'s.
[!node] skip

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out app.sngl
stderr '^app.sngl:4:18: 1 call into js:./lib was not evaluated, and a "none" build cannot call it at run time: running it needs --allow-eval="js:\./lib" \(or `sngl trust --allow-eval="js:\./lib"` to record it\)$'

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-eval=js:./lib app.sngl
grep 'HELLO' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import lib "js:./lib"

const greeting = lib.shout("hello")

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=greeting)
}
-- lib/index.ts --
/** @sngl-pure */
export function shout(s: string): string {
    return s.toUpperCase();
}
